scope: Aggregate metrics and provenance only; no page images, transcriptions, OCR outputs, or per-page or per-crop scores.

license.corpus_attribution: The Yiddish OCR Corpus, Assaf Urieli and the Yiddish Book Center
license.note: The corpus images and text are not included. Obtain them from the corpus and observe their applicable rights and license.

book_sample.citation: Urieli, Clooney, Sigiel and Leyfer, Jochre 3 and the Yiddish OCR corpus, https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.08442
book_sample.sample_digest_note: SHA-256 of the retained newline-delimited test-ids.txt, recorded after scoring; no claim is made that the digest itself was published before the runs.
book_sample.reader_input_note: Jochre and Tesseract page modes read whole pages. Qwen and the Tesseract line mode used corpus line boxes and reading order.
book_sample.training_note: This study did not train an adapter on the corpus. Jochre 3 uses its previously trained models.

newspaper_sample.source: qwen-nonenglish-v1 Yiddish units selected from a damaged-OCR pool
newspaper_sample.selection_digest_note: SHA-256 of the retained selection.jsonl, recorded after scoring.
newspaper_sample.sampling: Rank pages within each title by sha256('yid-silver-202611:' + doc_id), select 20, and choose one crop per page by sha256(doc_id + ':' + crop_id).
newspaper_sample.reference: No human transcription; all newspaper distances measure agreement, not accuracy.

readers.jochre3: Jochre 3 1.1.4 and layout server 1.0.5, whole pages or newspaper crops
readers.tesseract: Tesseract 5.5.0 with tessdata_best, yid and yid+eng whole-page PSM 3 at 300 dpi; yid line PSM 7 is a separate control
readers.qwen: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct Q4_K_M via usnm_qwen 1.17, llama-server b8799 on Vulkan and an RTX 2060 SUPER, one read per crop

qwen_versions.1: default image token minimum, no loop guard
qwen_versions.3: default image token minimum with loop guard
qwen_versions.4: 1024 minimum image tokens with loop guard

scoring.book_primary: Mean of per-page Levenshtein edits divided by reference characters after Jochre YIVO simplification and collapsed paragraph breaks.
scoring.book_raw: Pooled CER using the gold-set normalization with Hebrew points removed; this is a secondary metric.
scoring.newspaper_symmetric: Sum of Levenshtein edits divided by the sum of the longer normalized reading lengths, with YIVO simplification, Hebrew points removed and whitespace collapsed.
scoring.timing_note: Tesseract line records did not supply request timing; zero time in its line-summary row does not mean instantaneous inference.
